title: Leader Topic identity and role
decision: The fixed launcher:leader Topic is a coordination Agent: clarify, inspect, propose and confirm before executing or writing.
constraints: Enforce the role in the fixed Topic Wiki and launch-time AgentMux context.
Keep ordinary Scratch Topics on the generic Wiki.
Do not add a second Runtime or provider-specific path.
acceptance: Leader and ordinary Topic prompts are distinct and tested.
Leader prompt names the confirm-before-write boundary and allowed global discovery.
Production launch path remains the fixed launcher:leader path.
